title: Badesee Going am Wilden Kaiser
highlights: Repeatedly voted the most beautiful natural swimming lake in Tyrol
Fed by crystal-clear spring water flowing directly from the cliffs of the Wilder Kaiser
Broad white sand beach featuring a separate shallow-water bay for children
Tyrol's longest open-air waterslide providing 100 meters of exhilarating slides
kurzbeschreibung: Badesee Going is among Tirol's most beautiful natural swimming lakes, featuring a white sandy beach and Kaiser mountain spring water.
beschreibung:
Natural Swimming Paradise at the Foot of the Kaiser

The Badesee Going on the Wilder Kaiser is considered one of the most picturesque and cleanest natural swimming lakes in all of Austria. Fed by fresh mountain springs from the Kaisergebirge, the lake impresses with crystal-clear water and an incomparable mountain backdrop.

Sandy Beach and 100-Metre Slide

With its fine, white sandy beach, spacious sunbathing lawns, and a separate shallow water bay, the lake is an ideal destination for families. An absolute hit among children and teenagers is the 100-metre-long open-air water slide. The lakeside buffet serves snacks and cool drinks on the sunny lakeside terrace.
